$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

seed.description: Picks the small random variations; the same seed always gives the same character.

gender.description: 0 = female, 1 = male; values between blend the two.

age.description: Normalized age: 0.5 = 25 years, 1 = 90 years; the lowest allowed is 12 years. ageYears is easier to read.

height.description: 0 = shortest, 0.5 = average for the gender and age, 1 = tallest. Not centimetres: the exported height depends on the whole body.

proportions.description: Below 0.5 = less common proportions, 0.5 = neutral, 1 = idealised proportions.

african.description: Share of African features in the ethnic mix. african, asian and caucasian are relative: they are divided by their total, so 1/1/1 is an even mix.

asian.description: Share of Asian features in the ethnic mix, relative to african and caucasian.

caucasian.description: Share of Caucasian features in the ethnic mix, relative to african and asian.

modifiers.description: Fine body sliders by ID, such as nose or jaw shapes: -1..1 for two-way sliders, 0..1 for one-way.

skin.description: A skin texture ID, or auto to choose one from the ethnic mix.

skinTint.description: #RRGGBB multiplied over the skin texture: it can only darken. #ffffff leaves it unchanged.

hairTint.description: #RRGGBB multiplied over a textured hairstyle: it can only darken. #ffffff leaves it unchanged.

hairColor.description: #RRGGBB colour of the generated hairstyles, such as braids, buzz cuts and spikes.

outfit.description: A complete outfit or outfit set ID, or none to dress with separate pieces (top, jacket, bottom, shoes, hat).

underwear.description: Briefs under the clothes. Only adults (18+) can switch it off.

garmentStyles.description: Pattern and colour per garment ID: {"pattern": ..., "color": "#RRGGBB", "color2": "#RRGGBB"}; jerseys (football_shirt, basketball_jersey) also take "number" (0-99).

outfitTint.description: #RRGGBB multiplied over the outfit texture: it can only darken. #ffffff leaves it unchanged.

detail.description: low: game proxy, about 5-10k triangles. medium: full body, about 30-40k. high: smoothed body and clothing, about 100-120k.

rig.description: game: 65 bones with Mixamo names (retargets to Mixamo, Unity Humanoid and Unreal). game_lite: 25 bones, no fingers. full: 163 MakeHuman bones including the face. none: no skeleton.

faceBones.description: Adds jaw and eye bones for facial animation.

restPose.description: A: the natural A-pose. T: a T-pose, as Mixamo and Unity Humanoid expect.

animations.description: Include the animation clips in GLB and FBX exports.

vehicle.description: A vehicle fitted to the rider and exported as its own file; auto picks the one the riding clips need.

faceShapes.description: Export facial blend shapes (expressions, blinking). Off bakes the expression into the mesh.

speechShapes.description: With faceShapes: also export the mouth shapes for lip-sync.

ageYears.description: Human years; use instead of normalized age, never both.
